notes: The dash gloss «ونسبه غير ابن وهب فقال ابن عبد الله بن كعب بن مالك» gives another nasab for the same ʿAbd al-Raḥmān: a wording variant, left out; editor glosses are not links.

The second route («قال ابن شهاب ثم سألت ابنا لسلمة ... فحدثني عن أبيه») keeps the shared head Abu al-Tahir → Ibn Wahb → Yunus → Ibn Shihab, as in the worked example 3; its son of Salama is unnamed and «أبيه» is a relation.
The phrase «ابنا لسلمة بن الأكوع» names the son only by his father; he is unnamed.
